# Mendozer Investments

> Multi-sector Namibian group working since 2009 across construction, technology, cooling, logistics, energy, and tourism. Registered close corporation CC/2009/2399, Windhoek, Namibia.

Mendozer Investments CC delivers construction, technology, cooling, logistics, energy, and tourism work from Namibia. This site publishes verified group information, sector overviews, specialist construction services, and public records. It presents no unverified project claims and no fabricated metrics.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mendozer.com/): group overview, sector explorer, and frequently asked questions
- [About](https://mendozer.com/about): the group, its leadership, and how it is introduced
- [Sectors](https://mendozer.com/sectors): each Mendozer sector, with its own page
- [Services](https://mendozer.com/services): specialist construction services, including electric fencing, walls and precast, gate automation, and general construction
- [Compliance](https://mendozer.com/compliance): registration details and the public wholesale fuel distribution licence record
- [News](https://mendozer.com/blog): published news and event reports
- [Corner Spa announcement](https://mendozer.com/blog/corner-spa): Corner Spa, a concept by Mendozer Investments and the first project of Oryx Institute; website spa.mendozer.com; bookings +264 81 623 4788 (also WhatsApp)
- [Shu Splush](https://mendozer.com/shu-splash): sneaker-cleaning concept by Mendozer Investments at Dorado Valley Shopping Centre, Windhoek; call or WhatsApp 081 618 7210; 1 pair N$30, 2 pairs N$50
- [Shu Splush launch note](https://mendozer.com/blog/shu-splush-launch): announcement of the Shu Splush launch
- [Tangison technology partnership](https://mendozer.com/blog/tangison-technology-partnership): Tangison is Mendozer Investments' technology partner on a two-year agreement that began in August 2026
- [Contact](https://mendozer.com/contact): phone +264 85 777 7077 (also WhatsApp), email info@mendozer.com, Windhoek satellite office

## Facts

- Legal name: Mendozer Investments CC, registration CC/2009/2399
- Operating since 2009; led by Managing Director Johannes Negumbo
- Wholesale fuel distribution under licence W/188/2017
- Office 2, Continental Building, Judge JP Karuaihe Street, Windhoek, Namibia
- Main number: +264 85 777 7077 (085 777 7077 within Namibia), also on WhatsApp; email: info@mendozer.com
- Corner Spa (spa.mendozer.com) is a concept by Mendozer Investments and the first project of Oryx Institute: Mendozer Investments is the financing partner, Oryx Institute (oryxinstitute.org) leads operations, bookings +264 81 623 4788
- Shu Splush is a sneaker-cleaning concept by Mendozer Investments at Dorado Valley Shopping Centre, close to Ara bar, Windhoek: every wash includes all treatments, 1 pair N$30, 2 pairs N$50, Black Friday 1 pair N$25 and 2 pairs N$40, call or WhatsApp 081 618 7210
- Tangison is the group's technology partner under a two-year agreement that began in August 2026, building and maintaining the group's websites
- The Managing Director's direct line, +264 81 777 7077, is listed on the contact page for record purposes
